commits.script:
# palette v2: lifted hair so the silhouette separates from a dark terminal; darker iris so eyes don't go hair-coloured
set ol=#3e2a2c w=1.6 wi=0.9 skin=#fcdcc4 skinS=#eab89c hair=#6e4e3c hairS=#553a2d hairL=#8c6a52 top=#ea8278 topS=#cc6660 wht=#fbf8f4 whtS=#d9d5df red=#cf3540 skirt=#82343c skirtS=#622229 skirtL=#9a4650 sock=#fbf8f4 sockS=#d3d3de shoe=#8c5030 shoeS=#683a22 iris=#4a2e22 irisD=#1e100a tog=#f0c040
rename-layer name=paint to=fig
layer name=preview-bg visible=false below=fig
fill in=canvas color=#1e2127
layer name=fig

# walk figure
layer name=fig
# far arm (swinging forward, behind the body)
set fa=25.4,40.4;28.2,45;30.6,48.4
stroke path=$fa width=6 color=$ol
stroke path=$fa width=3 color=$topS
stroke path=29.4,47;30.8,48.8 width=3 color=$whtS cap=butt
fill in=circle(31.8,50.2,1.9) color=$skinS
stroke path=circle(31.8,50.2,1.9) width=$w color=$ol
# far leg (back)
set fl=21,56;17.6,63.4;15,69.6
stroke path=$fl width=6.2 color=$ol
stroke path=$fl width=3.2 color=$skinS
stroke path=17.4,63.8;15,69.6 width=3.2 color=$sockS cap=butt
set fsh=ellipse(14.8,71.8,3.7,1.9,38)
fill in=$fsh color=$shoeS
stroke path=$fsh width=$w color=$ol
# near leg (forward)
set nl=24.4,56;27.4,63.4;30,69.8
stroke path=$nl width=6.2 color=$ol
stroke path=$nl width=3.2 color=$skin
stroke path=27.6,63.8;30,69.8 width=3.2 color=$sock cap=butt
stroke path=26,64.4;29,63.4 width=$wi color=$ol cap=butt
set nsh=blob(28,72.6;29.4,70;33,70.2;36.2,71.2;36.4,73.4;29,74.3)
fill in=$nsh color=$shoe
fill in=rect(27,73,10,2) color=$shoeS clip=fig
stroke path=$nsh width=$w color=$ol
# collar flap on the back (white, red stripe), peeks out below the hair
set flap=poly(14.6,39;20.6,38.6;20.6,48;14.2,48)
fill in=$flap color=$wht
stroke path=15.6,39.6;15.4,47;20.4,47 width=0.8 color=$red smooth=false
stroke path=$flap width=$wi color=$ol
# skirt
set sk=poly(17.6,49.4;29.4,49.4;34,59.4;12.6,59.4)
fill in=$sk color=$skirt
stroke path=20.5,51.5;17.5,59.2 width=1 color=$skirtS cap=butt
stroke path=24,51.5;23.6,59.2 width=1 color=$skirtS cap=butt
stroke path=27.2,51.5;29.6,59.2 width=1 color=$skirtS cap=butt
stroke path=$sk width=$w color=$ol
# torso: rounded box, chest to the right
set tor=blob(18.6,40;21.6,37.4;26.4,37.4;28.8,40;29.6,46;29.6,50.6;23.6,51.2;18,50.6;17.8,45)
fill in=$tor color=$top
stroke path=$tor width=$w color=$ol
# neck
fill in=rect(24.6,33,4.4,5.6) color=$skinS
stroke path=29,33;29,37.6 width=$wi color=$ol cap=butt
# front collar + cord + toggle
set fc=poly(25.4,37.4;28.8,38.4;30,44;27.2,40.8)
fill in=$fc color=$wht
stroke path=26,38;29.4,43 width=0.7 color=$red
stroke path=$fc width=$wi color=$ol
stroke path=29.6,44.6;30,50 width=0.7 color=$red
fill in=rect(29,43.4,1.8,1.8) color=$tog

# walk head + near arm
layer name=fig
# hair mass: crown + hair hanging down the back (ends ~7 px below the shoulder, like stand)
set hm=blob(11.4,12;14.6,6;19.8,3.2;25,2.7;30,3.5;34.2,6.2;36.6,10.4;36.4,16;31,21;27,25;25,33;23.6,40;22,45.4;19.4,46.4;16.4,45.8;14,46.4;12.4,45;11.6,36;11,22)
fill in=$hm color=$hair
layer name=hmask visible=false
clear
fill in=$hm color=#000
layer name=fig
# one hard shade: the hanging hair behind the ear
fill in=poly(19,26;26,24;25,48;17,48) color=$hairS clip=hmask
stroke path=arc(23.6,15.6,12.2,205,300) width=1.6 color=$hairL cap=butt
stroke path=$hm width=$w color=$ol
# face: skin from the hair curtain to the front, nose bump, chin
set face=blob(25.4,13.6;30,11.6;34.6,12;36,15.6;36.2,22;37.4,25.4;37.4,26.8;36.2,27.8;36.4,30.4;35,33;32.4,35;28.6,35.4;25,33.6;24.4,24)
fill in=$face color=$skin
stroke path=$face width=$w color=$ol
# bangs + curtain in front of the ear, clipped to the forehead
set edge=34.6,19.4;33,17.8;32,20.4;30.4,18;29,20.8;27.6,18.6;25.6,22.4;25.4,28;24.8,33.6;23.4,38.6;22,42.4
fill in=poly(19,4;30,4.3;34.6,7;36.4,11.6;35.8,16;$edge;18,30) color=$hair
stroke path=$edge smooth=false width=1.1 color=$ol
# eye: tall white oval, dark iris toward the front, catchlight, top lid
fill in=ellipse(31.6,25.4,2.6,4.2) color=$wht
fill in=ellipse(32.6,26.4,1.8,3) color=$iris
fill in=ellipse(33,27,0.9,1.4) color=$irisD
fill in=rect(31,24,1,1) color=#ffffff
stroke path=28.8,22.4;31.4,20.9;34.2,21.8 width=1.2 color=$ol
# mouth
stroke path=34.6,31.2;36,31.4 width=0.8 color=$ol
# near arm (swinging back), crosses the flap
set na=23.6,40.4;21.4,45.2;18.8,49.2
stroke path=$na width=6 color=$ol
stroke path=$na width=3 color=$top
stroke path=24.4,42;22.4,46.6 width=1 color=$topS
stroke path=19.8,47.8;18.4,49.8 width=3 color=$wht cap=butt
stroke path=19.4,48.1;18.3,49.7 width=0.8 color=$red cap=butt
fill in=circle(17.6,51.4,1.9) color=$skin
stroke path=circle(17.6,51.4,1.9) width=$w color=$ol
